display_name: Deep Sky Jigsaw VR - 110 Messier Puzzles
display_long_description:
**Rebuild the universe—now with Messier objects!**

**Deep Sky Jigsaw VR v1.2** turns the night sky into a giant 3D jigsaw puzzle for Meta Quest.

Choose a constellation puzzle, or select any Messier object from **M001 to M110** and rebuild its real astronomical image as a 64-piece jigsaw puzzle in space.

Grab each piece with your controller, then rotate and tilt it until it matches the correct position and orientation.

Use stars, constellation lines, the Milky Way, nebulae, galaxies, and Messier images as clues.

For Messier puzzles, reconstruct real nebulae, galaxies, and star clusters piece by piece.

Version 1.2 also adds **Messier progress tracking** and integrates completed Messier objects into the ranking system.

You can save an interrupted Messier puzzle and continue it later.

Complete more objects, improve your ranking, and challenge yourself to restore all **110 Messier objects**.

When the final piece clicks into place, the complete constellation or deep-sky object appears before you.

**Grab it. Rotate it. Fit it back into place. Complete the universe with your own hands.**
